build_progress_bar: build a progress bar from args and iterator using build_progress_bar with tqdm or json format
create_json_progress_bar: create a json_progress_bar instance to log training stats as JSON output at intervals
create_tqdm_progress_bar: create a tqdm_progress_bar instance to display a tqdm progress bar with epoch prefix
create_tensorboard_log_wrapper: create a tensorboard_log_wrapper to log training stats to tensorboard alongside a wrapped progress bar
format_stat: format a stat value using format_stat to convert AverageMeter, TimeMeter, or StopwatchMeter to string
